row.title: DISCLOSE-1: the full specification is private; the working product and the template stay public
row.body: Owner 2026-11-26: the specification should not be up for grabs and the template repository carries only what a new instance needs to deploy. Decision: full specification text, rule narrative and company papers live in private ultrastable/ops (spec/, admin/, no workflow); code, public contracts, definitions, white papers, requirement IDs and conformance counts stay public; the seed is slimmed to the operating agreement plus the generated rules index. What was already public stays public (no history rewrite: the ruleset refuses force pushes). New specification text is never committed to a public branch. Detail and sequence: docs/handoff/disclosure-split.md
